description: This file defines the CordonHelper class and associated functions for managing Kubernetes node cordoning and uncordoning operations.

classes.name: CordonHelper
classes.description: A helper class for cordoning and uncordoning Kubernetes nodes, managing node schedulability status.

methods.name: NewCordonHelper
methods.description: Creates a new CordonHelper instance for a specific node.

methods.name: NewCordonHelperFromRuntimeObject
methods.description: Creates a CordonHelper from a runtime object, converting it to a node if possible.

methods.name: UpdateIfRequired
methods.description: Checks if the node's schedulability status needs to be updated to match the desired state.

methods.name: PatchOrReplace
methods.description: Updates the node's status using patch or replace, with default context.

methods.name: PatchOrReplaceWithContext
methods.description: Updates the node's status using patch or replace, with a custom context.
